caption: Edge labels are each node's local matrix, boxes show what that gives in the world. The base's 90° turn sends the arm's local (2, 0) to world (10, 2) m, not (12, 0).

spec.aria: Scene graph of World, then Base attached with local matrix T(10,0) rotated 90 degrees, then Arm at local (2,0), whose world position is (10,2) metres.
